verdict.rationale: Ashby offers webhook-based automated responses to events (candidate status changes, job updates) and 'custom agents for repeated workflows' invocable via Ashby Assistant/Slack, which provide some automation building blocks. However, these are largely reactive/event-triggered or user-invoked rather than clearly autonomous, scheduled background agents; missing for 10: explicit documentation of autonomous scheduling/background execution without a trigger or user prompt, and independent confirmation of agents running unattended.
